annotations.title: US address geocode with Census geographies

description: Geocodes a one-line US address, or reverse-geocodes a lat/lon point, to coordinates and the Census geographies containing it: state and county FIPS, county subdivision, place, tract, block group, block, ZCTA, congressional and state legislative districts, school districts, urban area, metro or micro area, metro division, CSA, PUMA, census region and division, plus ground elevation in feet. Sources: US Census Geocoder (current benchmark), USGS 3DEP elevation service (EPQS). Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: One-line US street address (5 to 100 characters). Mutually exclusive with lat/lon.

elevation.description: Include USGS ground elevation (default true). The USGS service is slow and can add up to about 7 s to the response; false skips it.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees for reverse lookup, paired with lon. US states, DC, Puerto Rico and island areas.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees for reverse lookup, paired with lat.
